name: Kobold Faith
body:
Drawbacks
Kobold Faith
Source Kobolds of Golarion pg. 13
Category Race
Requirement(s) Kobold
You are one of the diehard kobold faithful, respected in your kobold community. You gain a +2 trait bonus on Diplomacy checks when dealing with other kobolds. Additionally, if your deity grants the Artifice, Earth, or Trickery domain, then your kobold faith unlocks a corresponding subdomain: Trap, Radiation, or Ambush.
